value.answer: Sorry, that's a hard thing to be looking for. If it gets urgent where you are, reach emergency services right away. For free, Ontario Structured Psychotherapy covers adults 18+ in Ontario with depression, anxiety or anxiety-related issues like OCD or PTSD. You don't need a health card or family doctor, you can self-refer at ontariohealth.ca/osp, and it's offered by video, phone or in person. I couldn't find which local network covers your part of Toronto, so that page is where you'd sort it. For paid but cheap options in Toronto or online: Affordable Therapy Services has online sessions from $50 on a sliding scale, Get Reconnected has sessions with supervised student interns at $45, and the Affordable Therapy Network has a directory of 500+ therapists, mostly in Toronto or online. Toronto Community Psychotherapy & Counselling Centre has free counselling by application. Some of these listings are a bit dated, so prices may have moved.
